countingUnit: One distinct taught/coursework master's award/programme; modes, rounds and intakes are offerings, not new programmes

universities.noteEn: All 72 visible 2027/28 table rows reconciled to 69 admission codes. Dates/modes remain raw observations, not checked admissions or live-portal evidence.

49 distinct Hong Kong-delivery master's listings after merging cross-school duplicates; one doctorate and five named BNBU/Zhuhai programme entries excluded. Directory presence does not prove open admissions.

44 master's listings after excluding five doctorates. MRes in Advanced Data Science is retained because the School of Data Science explicitly categorises it as taught postgraduate. Concentrations and double-degree options are not extra programmes.

universities.noteEn: Year-specific catalogues mix MSc, MEng and research awards. The DISC MEng route is transfer-only, not a new direct-entry master; keep it outside default browsing.

universities.nameEn: Singapore University of Technology and Design
universities.noteEn: 18 distinct coursework listings across both filtered pages, reconciled against 21 unfiltered entries. Three research routes excluded, including Innovation by Design. Individually named MTD routes count separately; modes/intakes do not.
